_ghi_chu: Spec Sec11.6 tu khai cot action/trigger cua no la DICH CAN TRA.
Bang duoi la ket qua chay `node src/xuat_catalog.js --liet-ke` ngay
24/09/2026 tren dung cac ban da ghim o `pieces` phia tren.
`co` = ten spec doan DUNG. `khong` = KHONG TON TAI o ban nay.
`thay` = co mot action gan nghia; day la mot THAY THE co review, va
no phai doc duoc trong diff -- spec cam thay im lang.

google-sheets._25_09_dynamic: insert_row/update_row tung BO_QUA vi `values` la PropertyType.DYNAMIC (khong co trong `xuat_catalog.KIEU`). Vong P-C (25/09) them anh xa `DYNAMIC -> 'json'` (nguon: framework `dynamic-prop.ts`, `DynamicPropsValue = Type.Record(Type.String(), DynamicProp)` -- ve day no LA mot JSON object phang). Nguoi soan tu dien object, vd `{"A": "gia tri"}`; khong dung form dong nhu UI Activepieces vi runner cua ta khong chay engine cua ho (spec Sec11.1).

gmail.gmail_send_email_KHONG_mo: BO khoi palette: tham so bat buoc `receiver` la PropertyType.ARRAY (`Type.Array(Type.Unknown())`, framework array-property.ts). Tu vung LTT (`luoc_do._KHUNG`) chua co kieu 'mang chuoi phang' -- 'json' khai `type:object` (sai voi mot mang), 'json[]' khai `items:object` (sai voi phan tu string). Anh xa ep se sai SCHEMA, khong chi thieu UI dong nhu DYNAMIC/RICH_TEXT o tren. ⛔ Khong tu doan 'json[]' -- can sua `platform_core/workflow/luoc_do.py` (them mot dong tu vung that su), ngoai pham vi mot lan sua `xuat_catalog.js`. Ghi lai o day de lan sau khoi do lai.
gmail.trigger poll: co: gmail_new_email_received da dua len palette.
